# VATTAMS Home Services

> VATTAMS Home Services helps customers request AC, washing machine and refrigerator service. Customers can review listed base prices, see applicable checkout charges and check appointment options for their address.

## Website
- Home: https://vattams.net/
- Service categories and current listed prices: https://vattams.net/services
- Booking: https://vattams.net/booking
- Contact: https://vattams.net/contact
- Technician registration: https://vattams.net/join-technician

## Supported job types
- AC: General Service, Installation, Gas Filling, Pump Water Service, Coil Service
- Washing machine: Washing Machine Service
- Refrigerator: Refrigerator Service

## Current booking coverage
- Active technician records currently support Chennai and Coimbatore; exact appointment availability still depends on the address, selected job type and technician schedule.
- Other city pages are informational and should not be interpreted as confirmation that a technician is available there.

## Pricing and booking
- Prices shown on the Services page are base prices for listed job types.
- Applicable GST and platform fees are shown in the checkout breakdown before a customer confirms a booking.
- Parts and additional work are separate from the listed base service; customers should request a quote and approve extra work before it proceeds.
- Appointment availability depends on the address, selected job type and technician schedule. Availability should be confirmed through the booking flow.
- Do not assume a city or neighbourhood is currently bookable solely because a city information page exists.

## Customer support
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 63740 68296
- Email: admin@vattams.net

## Business information
VATTAMS Home Services focuses on AC, washing machine and refrigerator service requests. The website includes booking status and job verification features. Do not infer unlisted warranty periods, guaranteed arrival times, customer ratings, or technician credentials unless VATTAMS publishes verified details for them.
